enGB: The medium gains the spirit’s listed seance boon and lesser spirit power for 24 hours. The medium also gains the spirit’s intermediate spirit power at 6th level, its greater spirit power at 11th level, and its supreme spirit power at 17th level. After a day, the medium loses contact with the channeled spirit and can perform another seance.
zhCN: 通灵者获得该英灵所列的降灵奖励与次级英灵之力，持续24小时。通灵者还会在6级获得中等英灵之力，11级获得高等英灵之力，17级获得至高英灵之力。一天之后，通灵者会与所降灵的英灵失去联系，并可再次举行降灵仪式。

enGB:
A medium can allow his spirit to gain 2 additional points of influence over him in order to add 1d6 to a value modified by his spirit bonus.
 The medium must be conscious and aware to use this ability. At 10th level, the medium’s spirit surge die increases to 1d8, and at 20th level it increases to 1d10. The bonuses last for 1 round (6 seconds).
zhCN:
通灵者可以让英灵对自己的共鸣增加2点，使一项能获得英灵同调的数值额外获得1d6加值。
通灵者必须保持清醒且具有意识才能使用此能力。10级时，灵力奔涌的骰子提升为1d8；20级时提升为1d10。加值持续1轮（6秒）。

enGB: Mediums channel spirits into themselves, using their own bodies as vessels for astral entities spawned from myths and legends. A medium balances his need for the spirits' power with the danger of allowing such beings influence over his mind.
zhCN: 通灵者将英灵引入自身，以肉身作为容器，承载诞生于神话与传说的星界存在。通灵者必须在借用英灵力量的需求，与任由这些存在影响自己心智的危险之间保持平衡。

enGB: Mediums are proficient with all simple {g|Encyclopedia:Weapon_Proficiency}weapons{/g}, light armor, and medium armor. A medium can cast {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}spells{/g} while wearing armor.
zhCN: 通灵者擅长所有简易{g|Encyclopedia:Weapon_Proficiency}武器{/g}、轻甲和中甲。通灵者可以穿着护甲施放{g|Encyclopedia:Spell}法术{/g}。

enGB: When a medium channels a spirit, he gains a bonus on certain checks and abilities, depending on the spirit. A 1st-level medium's spirit bonus is +1; it increases by 1 at 4th level and every 4 levels thereafter.
zhCN: 通灵者降灵时，会根据所选英灵，在特定检定和能力上获得加值。1级通灵者的英灵同调为+1；4级时以及此后每4级，该加值再提高1。

enGB: Each day, you channel a spirit and gain its seance boon and spirit powers until you rest. The first spirit adds 1 point of influence. The Mythic Multiple Spirits ability allows additional, different spirits. All active spirits share accumulated influence. At 3 points the spirits' penalties take effect. The base influence cap is 3 plus half your medium level plus your Charisma modifier; powers that would exceed your cap cannot be used. Rest ends channeling and resets influence to 0.
zhCN: 每天，你可以降灵一位英灵，获得其降灵奖励与英灵之力，直到休息。首次降灵增加1点共鸣。选择“神话·多重降灵”后，可降灵更多不同英灵。所有已降灵英灵共用累计共鸣；共鸣达到3点时，承受这些英灵的共鸣惩罚。基础共鸣上限为3点加上通灵者等级的一半再加上魅力调整值，不能使用会超过上限的能力。休息结束降灵并将共鸣重置为0。

enGB: Influence starts at 0 and accumulates as you accept a spirit's power. Channeling your first spirit adds 1 point; powers with an influence cost add their listed points instead of spending a pool. All channeled spirits share one counter. The base cap is 3 plus half your medium level plus your Charisma modifier. An ability cannot add more influence than the cap allows; free spirit surges can still be used at the cap. At 3 or more points you suffer a -2 initiative penalty and the penalties of all active spirits; increasing the cap does not move this threshold. The counter resets to 0 when your spirits leave after resting. Ability icons show current influence / cap.
zhCN: 共鸣从0开始，随接受英灵力量逐步积累。首次降灵增加1点共鸣；有共鸣代价的能力会增加相应点数。所有已降灵英灵共用一个计数器。基础上限为3点加上通灵者等级的一半，再加上魅力调整值；无法使用会使共鸣超出上限的能力，但免费的灵力奔涌仍可使用。共鸣达到3点时，先攻承受-2减值，并承受所有已降灵英灵的共鸣惩罚；提高上限不会改变这一阈值。休息、英灵离去后，共鸣重置为0。能力图标显示“当前共鸣/上限”。

enGB: At 2nd level, a medium can share his channeled spirit’s aid with his allies. All allies who participate in the medium’s seance gain the channeled spirit’s seance boon for 24 hours.
zhCN: 2级时，通灵者可以与盟友共享所降灵英灵的帮助。所有参与通灵者降灵仪式的盟友都会获得该英灵的降灵奖励，持续24小时。

enGB: At 9th level, once per day as a standard action, you can soothe your channeled spirits and reduce accumulated influence by 1. This cannot reduce influence below 1 while any spirit remains channeled. Penalties end immediately if influence drops below 3.
zhCN: 9级起，每天一次，以一个标准动作安抚已降灵的英灵，使累计共鸣降低1点。只要仍有英灵降灵，共鸣便不能因此降至1点以下。若共鸣降至3点以下，共鸣惩罚立即解除。

enGB: At 19th level, he medium becomes a legend among spirits, particularly lesser spirits. He can use his spirit surge ability an additional two times per day without incurring influence, regardless of whether he accepts a taboo or channels a weaker spirit. When channeling a weaker spirit, he can use his spirit surge ability an additional four times per day for each power he forgoes, instead of an additional two times.
zhCN: 19级时，通灵者成为英灵之间的传奇人物，对弱小英灵而言尤为如此。无论是否接受禁忌或降灵较弱的英灵，通灵者每天都可以额外使用两次灵力奔涌，而不增加共鸣。降灵较弱的英灵时，每舍弃一种英灵之力，通灵者每天可以额外使用灵力奔涌的次数从两次增加为四次。

enGB:
At 15th level, as a swift action, a medium can allow his spirit to gain 1 point of influence over him in order to allow a portion of a legendary spirit from another legend to enter him for 1 round per level, granting him the intermediate spirit power from another legend.
If that power has a limited number of uses per day, the medium must keep track of the remaining uses even after the secondary spirit is gone; if the medium calls the secondary spirit again that day, it can grant the remaining uses of that power. If the medium uses an ability that incurs influence, the medium’s primary spirit gains that amount of influence over him, not the secondary spirit. The medium doesn’t gain the benefits of his spirit bonus from the secondary spirit.
The medium can end the trance of three early as a free action.
zhCN:
15级时，通灵者可以用一个迅捷动作，让当前英灵对自己的共鸣增加1点，邀请另一职阶的英灵的部分力量进入自身，持续每等级1轮，并获得该英灵的中等英灵之力。
如果该力量有每日使用次数限制，即使次要英灵已经离去，通灵者仍须记录剩余次数；如果当天再次召来该次要英灵，它只能提供该能力的剩余次数。如果通灵者使用会增加共鸣的能力，增加的是主要英灵对通灵者的共鸣，而非次要英灵。通灵者不会从次要英灵获得英灵同调。
通灵者可以用一个自由动作提前结束三重降灵。

enGB: During his seance, the medium can choose to channel a weaker spirit to gain its help without incurring as much of its influence. If he does so, he can forgo any number of spirit powers, starting with his most powerful spirit power. For each spirit power he forgoes, the medium can use his spirit surge ability twice without incurring influence. If the medium has the Spirit Mastery class feature this value increases to four additional times per power he forgoes.
zhCN: 举行降灵仪式时，通灵者可以选择降灵较弱的英灵，以较少的共鸣换取它的帮助。这样做时，通灵者可以从最强大的英灵之力开始，舍弃任意数量的英灵之力。每舍弃一种英灵之力，通灵者就可以使用两次灵力奔涌，而不增加共鸣。如果通灵者拥有英灵化职业能力，则每舍弃一种英灵之力，额外使用次数提高为四次。

enGB: At 20th level the medium is an open conduit to the Astral Plane. As a free action and by accepting 2 points of influence, he can briefly draw on one legend he is not currently channeling, gaining that legend's intermediate, greater and supreme spirit powers for 2 rounds. This grants no spirit bonus, seance boon or influence penalty from that legend.
zhCN: 20级时，通灵者成为与星界直接相连的通道。以一个自由动作并承受2点共鸣，通灵者可以临时引导一位当前未降灵职阶的英灵，获得该英灵的中等、高等与至高英灵之力，持续2轮。此能力不会提供该英灵的英灵同调、降灵奖励或共鸣惩罚。

enGB: At 10th level the medium learns to draw on more than one legend at a time. After channeling his primary spirit he can pick another legend he is not channeling and gain its intermediate spirit power; at 14th level he also gains that legend's greater spirit power, and at 18th level its supreme spirit power. This grants only that legend's spirit powers: no spirit bonus, seance boon, influence penalty or spells. The trance lasts until the channel ends or another legend is picked.
zhCN: 10级时，通灵者学会同时引导不同职阶的英灵之力。降灵主要英灵之后，他可以再选择一位当前未降灵职阶的英灵，获得它的中等英灵之力；14级时还会获得它的高等英灵之力，18级时还会获得它的至高英灵之力。此能力只提供该英灵的英灵之力，不会提供英灵同调、降灵奖励、共鸣惩罚或法术。此降灵持续到本次降灵结束或改选其他英灵为止。

enGB: At 4th level you forge a deeper bond with the experience and skills of your spirits: you gain one additional feat for which you qualify. At 8th level and every 4 levels thereafter (12th, 16th and 20th) you gain another additional feat.
zhCN: 4 级时，你与英灵的经验和技能建立了更深的联系：你获得一个满足先决条件的额外专长。8 级及之后每 4 级（12 级、16 级、20 级）你再各获得一个额外专长。

enGB:
You have learned to harness mythic power to control your spirits.
Effect: Your influence cap increases by an amount equal to your mythic rank.
zhCN:
你学会了利用神话之力制御英灵的方法。
效果：你的共鸣上限增加等于你的神话阶层的点数。

enGB: Preparation spellbooks used by the Archmage and Hierophant spirits; their prepared spells use the Medium spellbook to cast.
zhCN: 大法师与大祭司英灵使用的准备法术书；准备的法术由通灵者本体法术书施放。

enGB: Your Medium spellbook uses Charisma-based spontaneous psychic casting, including spirit spells copied into it. Harmful fear and emotion effects prevent casting unless the spell is Logical. Thought components impose a -10 concentration modifier; Center Self removes this penalty for one round. Armor and shields do not cause arcane spell failure. Polymorph and the supported native silence effects do not prevent these spells; other spellcasting prohibitions still apply. Spirit preparation books cannot be used to cast directly.
zhCN: Your Medium spellbook uses Charisma-based spontaneous psychic casting, including spirit spells copied into it. Harmful fear and emotion effects prevent casting unless the spell is Logical. Thought components impose a -10 concentration modifier; Center Self removes this penalty for one round. Armor and shields do not cause arcane spell failure. Polymorph and the supported native silence effects do not prevent these spells; other spellcasting prohibitions still apply. Spirit preparation books cannot be used to cast directly.

enGB: As a move action, center yourself for one round, removing the -10 thought-component concentration penalty from your Medium spells. This does not remove emotion restrictions or grant a concentration bonus to other spellbooks.
zhCN: As a move action, center yourself for one round, removing the -10 thought-component concentration penalty from your Medium spells. This does not remove emotion restrictions or grant a concentration bonus to other spellbooks.

enGB: A Logical psychic spell does not require an emotion component and can be cast while affected by harmful fear or emotion. It uses a spell slot one level higher. Thought components still apply. This feat only enables Logical recipes for psychic spellbooks; it does not bypass other casting restrictions. CotW uses the same flag; acquiring both versions provides no additional benefit.
zhCN: A Logical psychic spell does not require an emotion component and can be cast while affected by harmful fear or emotion. It uses a spell slot one level higher. Thought components still apply. This feat only enables Logical recipes for psychic spellbooks; it does not bypass other casting restrictions. CotW uses the same flag; acquiring both versions provides no additional benefit.
绿林义贼罗宾汉（传奇诡术师）

enGB:
Hidden deep in the greenwood, Robin Hood is a champion of the oppressed and a peerless archer who defies tyranny and false laws, becoming a timeless legend of the forest. Only a non-evil, non-lawful medium can channel Robin Hood.
Spirit Bonus: When you channel Robin Hood, your spirit bonus applies on initiative, Dexterity checks, Dexterity-based skill checks (Mobility, Stealth, Thievery), Persuasion (Bluff) skill checks, and Reflex saves.
Seance Boon: Same as Trickster (choose one skill to gain a +1 bonus and treat it as a class skill).
Influence Penalty: Same as Trickster (Will, Fortitude, AC, CMD, and CMB take a penalty equal to your spirit bonus).
Outlaw Archer (Lesser, Su): You gain proficiency with longbows and shortbows (including composite bows) and double their range. When you can cast spells of the corresponding level, temporarily add the following known spells: 1st—Hurricane Bow, 2nd—Sense Vitals, 3rd—Chameleon Stride, Greater, 4th—Invisibility, Greater.
Surprise Strike (Intermediate, Su): Same as Trickster (sneak attack equal to your medium level, and the first attack against a target each day treats it as flat-footed).
Distant Archer (Greater, Su): When using a longbow or shortbow, gain a +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls for every full 10 feet between you and the target. Against targets more than 30 feet away, also add your positive Wisdom modifier to attack and damage rolls.
Unseen Legend (Supreme, Su): As a swift action, allow Robin Hood to gain 1 point of influence over you to gain the effects of greater invisibility for a number of rounds equal to your medium level, during which your attacks treat targets as flat-footed (even if normally immune to being flat-footed).
zhCN:
罗宾汉隐身于绿林深处，是劫富济贫的义贼，也是百步穿杨的神射手；他蔑视暴政与虚伪的律法，以长弓为弱者鸣不平，终成传唱千古的林间传奇。只有非邪恶且非守序阵营的通灵者方能降灵罗宾汉。
英灵同调：降灵罗宾汉时，你的英灵同调适用于先攻、敏捷检定、基于敏捷的技能检定（灵巧、隐匿、巧手）、沟通（唬骗）技能检定和反射豁免。
降灵奖励：同诡术师（选择一项技能，使用该技能的检定获得+1加值且视为本职技能）。
共鸣惩罚：同诡术师（意志、强韧、AC、CMD与CMB承受等同于英灵同调的减值）。
绿林义弓（次级，超自然）：你擅长长弓和短弓（包括复合弓），并使其射程翻倍。在达到对应法术环级时，临时获得以下已知法术：1环飓风之弓（Hurricane Bow）、2环弱点感知（Sense Vitals）、3环高等变色龙步（Chameleon Stride, Greater）、4环高等隐形术（Invisibility, Greater）。
诡击（中等，超自然）：同诡术师（获得等同于通灵者等级的偷袭，每天首次攻击目标时使其视为措手不及）。
百步穿杨（高等，超自然）：使用长弓或短弓时，攻击与伤害掷骰每与目标相距完整10尺获得+1加值；对距离超过30尺的目标，还将你的正感知调整值加到攻击与伤害掷骰上。
林影传奇（至高，超自然）：迅捷动作让罗宾汉对你的共鸣增加1点，获得持续等同于通灵者等级轮数的高等隐形术效果，期间你的攻击使目标视为措手不及（即使目标通常免疫措手不及）。

enGB: You gain proficiency with longbows and shortbows, including composite bows, and double their range. While channeling Robin Hood, add Hurricane Bow (Gravity Bow) at spell level 1, Sense Vitals at 2, Chameleon Stride, Greater at 3 and Invisibility, Greater at 4 to your known medium spells as those spell levels become available. These temporary spells are removed when this power ends; spells you already know are retained.
zhCN: 你擅长长弓和短弓（包括复合弓），并使其射程翻倍。降灵罗宾汉期间，在达到对应法术环级时，将以下法术临时加入你的通灵者已知法术：1环飓风之弓（Gravity Bow）、2环弱点感知（Sense Vitals）、3环高等变色龙步（Chameleon Stride, Greater）、4环高等隐形术（Invisibility, Greater）。此英灵之力结束时移除这些临时法术；你原本已知的法术会保留。

enGB: With a longbow or shortbow, gain +1 on attack and damage rolls per full 10 feet between you and the target. Against targets more than 30 feet away, also add your positive Wisdom modifier to attack and damage rolls.
zhCN: 使用长弓或短弓时，你与目标每相距完整10尺，攻击检定与伤害掷骰便获得+1加值。对距离超过30尺的目标，还将你的正感知调整值加到攻击检定与伤害掷骰上。

enGB: As a swift action, allow Robin Hood to gain 1 point of influence over you to become invisible as greater invisibility for a number of rounds equal to your medium level. While this effect lasts, your attacks treat their target as flat-footed, even if that target is normally immune to being flat-footed. This does not remove immunity to critical hits or precision damage. The effect ends when you lose this spirit power.
zhCN: 以一个迅捷动作，让罗宾汉对你的共鸣增加1点，获得等同于通灵者等级轮数的“高等隐形术”效果。持续期间，你的攻击将目标视为措手不及，即使目标通常免疫措手不及也不例外（但不会移除目标对重击或精准伤害的免疫）。失去此英灵之力时效果结束。
